hero.description: Allow users to log in to your applications using their existing Shuzimumin accounts, eliminating the need to create new accounts and providing secure, convenient identity verification services.

cta.title: Ready to login with Shuzimumin account?
cta.description: Start using Shuzimumin Connect now to provide secure and convenient authentication services for your applications.
cta.tagline: Use Shuzimumin account. Easy integration. Open source project.

footer.description: Shuzimumin Connect is an OAuth authentication platform based on Discourse SSO (Single Sign-On) user system. Through Shuzimumin Connect, you can let users log in to your applications using their existing Shuzimumin accounts without creating new accounts.

howItWorks.title: Simple Process, Quick Integration
howItWorks.description: Integrate Shuzimumin Community account authentication into your application with just a few simple steps.

register.title: Register Application
register.description: Register your application on the Shuzimumin Connect platform to get client ID and secret.

integrate.title: Integrate OAuth 2.0
integrate.description: Use our provided APIs and follow the documentation to integrate OAuth 2.0 authentication flow into your application.

authorize.title: User Authorization
authorize.description: Users log in through their Shuzimumin accounts without creating new accounts, simplifying user experience.

features.title: Powerful OAuth 2.0 Authentication Tool
features.description: Shuzimumin Connect provides all the tools you need to let users authenticate with Shuzimumin accounts, simplifying the login process.

oauth2.title: OAuth 2.0 Protocol
oauth2.description: Based on standard OAuth 2.0 protocol implementation, supports authorization code mode, ensuring secure and reliable authentication process.

sso.title: Shuzimumin SSO Integration
sso.description: Seamlessly integrate with Shuzimumin community single sign-on system, allowing users to authenticate with existing Shuzimumin accounts.

sync.title: User Information Sync
sync.description: Automatically sync user's basic information, avatar, roles and permissions, maintaining data consistency and real-time updates.

multiApp.title: Multi-Application Support
multiApp.description: Support multiple client applications access, unified user authentication management, simplifying system architecture and maintenance costs.

secure.title: Secure & Reliable
secure.description: Adopts encrypted transmission and signature verification mechanisms, ensuring authentication process security, preventing forgery and tampering.

easy.title: Simple & Easy
easy.description: Provides clear interfaces and documentation, developers can quickly integrate into their applications, reducing development costs.
